entry.title: Glance VLM
entry.summary: An open-source Python harness that reads typed answers from a local vision-language model's logits and returns probabilities without generation.

entry.title: Beep with JEV
entry.summary: An experiment giving JEV a way to express emotion and chat through audio beeps.

entry.title: JEV Graph Extraction
entry.summary: A JEV experiment that scores words for semantic significance, tags relevant words with IDs, and builds a graph from the highest-scoring words.

entry.title: Evaluator Bench
entry.summary: An evidence-linked research preview that scores the independence of third-party frontier AI evaluators under adjustable weights and evidence policies.

entry.title: Synthetic Players research
entry.summary: A paper and reproducible study asking whether a sixteen-persona LLM panel preserves treatment responses in repeated games, and showing that passing coarse marginal checks is cheap.

entry.title: Remoko
entry.summary: A mobile relay for coding agents that keeps Claude Code and Codex running on your computer while you check in, answer questions, and approve actions from your phone.

entry.title: Building a Repo-Centric Agent Stack
entry.summary: An article on putting the repository at the center of the agent stack.

entry.title: GraphCon Deck
entry.summary: An open-source graph-based presentation, where each node carries the slides it belongs to and the graph pulls nodes in and pushes them out as the talk advances.

entry.title: What Your Brain Knows About Long-Running Agents
entry.summary: An article on the hippocampus and cortex split as a model for long-running agents: a frozen model is a cortex, and the hard part is the organ that decides what it learns.

entry.title: The Shared Discovery Paradox
